utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm if we’re still just waiting on the full repair list? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know what I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do we have the date, time, and repair list for the drive yet? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still piecing it together, so I don’t have the full list yet. If you’ve heard any updates, I’d really appreciate them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, I may have missed an update, but I think they’re still collecting stuff for the repair drive. I don’t know the full list yet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — I haven’t heard the latest either, so I’m still in the dark on what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the latest, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know what I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Please let me know the date and time as soon as you hear, and I’ll bring the tools and tape.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I still don’t have the date, time, or repair list yet, but I can bring a couple of tools once you’ve got them set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus — I still don’t have the date, time, or repair list yet, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I know more.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates on the repair drive and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep looking for my toolbox in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair list over as soon as I have it, and I’ll keep passing along any updates too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be great. I really appreciate you keeping me posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll make sure everyone has the updated details. What do you need from me, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the exact address when you have it. I’ll bring the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What would you like me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you bring basic tools and any spare screws or nails?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I still don’t have the date, time, or repair list confirmed yet, but I’ll check and let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Mara — please let me know as soon as you have the date, time, and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — just send me the repair list when you have it, and I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’m still waiting on the latest repair list, but I’ll send it along as soon as I get it. The drive’s at the community center on Sunday, and I’ll pass on the address when Rosa sends it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet—I’m still trying to pin down exactly what supplies and hands we’re short on for the repair drive. If you hear anything, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear what’s still needed.
